cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle tea on Sunday. All right if my aunt and uncle come?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Two guests I can manage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Their three children are coming too; I'll squeeze them onto the bench.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll buy the cake. You only have to make the tea you agreed to; I'll keep the extra cups washed.

reason: Let the first two-person approval expand into a five-person service obligation, with A volunteering work to preserve B cooperation.
